meta.title: Memory switch
meta.description: Adds a switch to the composer tool row in every Web conversation plus a /memory on|off|toggle|status command usable in every environment (terminal, ACP/SDK, IM, headless presets). Turned off, that conversation stops exchanging information with other conversations: history search and trace tools are denied, cross-conversation references, team relay and team mailbox messages are filtered, IM group archives and external-agent bridges are denied, and the conversation disappears from cross-session search results; with OpenViking installed its recall, capture and commits are stopped too. State lives in the session log, so reload, resume and fork restore it; subagents inherit it. On by default.
